## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (for checks and parsers: every outcome is covered, written test-first)
- [ ] `make lint type test` passes locally
- [ ] Docs updated (including `docs/checks.md` if a check changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) and uses Conventional Commits
- [ ] Screenshots regenerated with `make screenshots` if the terminal or HTML output changed (never hand-edited)
- [ ] No embargoed, private or third-party report text is included
